sources.observation: Open limestone traceried arcades face the quadrangle. The walls mix dark quarry stone, pale jambs and steep slate roofs.

limitations: The footprints, cloister supports and main roof parts use the map. Individual slate pitches, relief details and some secondary elevations are estimated from exterior photographs.
